facts: National household schedule: 07:00-08:00 one queue, 08:00-20:00 two queues, 20:00-22:00 one queue.
Volynoblenergo records cancellation for all queues from 07:00 until further instruction.
Odesa is excluded for weather-related outages.
Lviv and Ivano-Frankivsk are not controls without equivalent operator-level archived records.
